mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wf_instance (workflow_id, workflow_type, status, current_node, context_json, create_by, create_time) VALUES (#{workflowId}, #{workflowType}, #{status}, #{currentNode}, #{contextJson}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
